37818-sketch-of-the-life-of-abraham-linc.description: A book by Isaac N. Arnold. Modern history furnishes no life more eventful and important, terminated by a death so dramatic, as that of the Martyr President. uslaw-usc-t30-s1009.title: 30 U.S.C. § 1009 — Relinquishment of geothermal rights
uslaw-usc-t30-s1009.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t30-s1009.description: United States Code, Title 30 (Mineral Lands And Mining); Chapter 23 (Geothermal Resources). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The holder of any geothermal lease at any time may make and file in the appropriate land office a written relinquishment of all rights under such lease or of any legal subdivision of the area covered by such lease. Such relinquishment shall be effective.
